description: One import, as its page on the Import tab shows it: the import itself; 'plan' — what would be carried (issues, comments, worklogs, attachments, versions), 'blockers' that stop it, the units it would spend ('units.over' true means start_import needs acceptUnits), the Jira statuses and where they could go, the Jira issue types with the type here each is suggested to go to ('mapsTo', read off what Jira says the type is, not only its name) and the project's 'targetTypes', 'people' — every Jira account with its accountId, name, address where Jira shows it, how much it did and the member it matches — and what is not carried; 'choices' made at the start; 'report' once done — 'keptLocal' are issues somebody changed here, left as they are, and 'keptLocalWhy' says what kept each (a person and who, an agent, or a change the history does not explain); changes made only by the status sync, a rule or a deployment do not keep an issue ('afterAutomatic' counts those); 'members' — the company's people by username, for matching; 'links' — who the company already said each Jira account is. The company's administrator only.
name: get_import
title: Get import
